text: Long-term language training students will study Chinese for one academic year or more, while short-term language training students will study Chinese for one semester or less. Through Chinese learning, students can make progress in Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing, and students generally can pass HSK level 4. There are two registration periods every year: around March and September. Students who attend at least 2/3 of the total class hours of the subjects, take the exams of all subjects and get qualified results, will be awarded the certificate of completion issued by CIE.
